title: Languages in bounded-depth circuit families
statement: For a natural number $d$ and a language $L$ over Boolean words, say that $L$ belongs to this class if there is a family of Boolean circuits represented as directed acyclic graphs, with gates of fan-in at most two, polynomial size, and polylogarithmic depth with parameter $d$, whose language is exactly $L$.
